name: Vitally MCP
description:
Customer Success teams don't lack data — they lack a single place to make sense of it. Signals live in one tool, conversations in another, notes somewhere else entirely, and by the time it's all pulled together, the moment to act has often passed. Vitally brings all this data together under one roof, so CS teams can proactively fight churn, spot expansion opportunities, and grow their customer relationships. 

The Vitally MCP connector brings that same account intelligence into Claude, wherever you're already working. Ask about any customer and get answers grounded in the full context your team has captured — not just the surface-level number, but the substance behind it: what customers have actually said, done, and asked for. Every answer is scoped to exactly what your own Vitally login can already see, so nothing surfaces that you couldn't already find yourself.

Take action on customer data directly from a Claude chat, capturing what you've learned, moving work forward, and keeping your workspace current without switching tools or losing the thread.

Built for CSMs, CS leaders, and Account Management teams who want to spend less time hunting for context and more time staying a step ahead of churn and unlocking growth — all without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vitally MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vitally MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vitally.io/mcp/v0. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vitally MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vitally MCP lists 20 MCP tools, including create_custom_object, create_note, create_task, retrieve_content, search_accounts, search_conversations, search_custom_objects, search_docs, search_goals, search_indicators, search_meetings, and search_notes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vitally MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vitally MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Vitally MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vitally MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vitally MCP is developed by Vitally. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
